name: Plugin Manager
author: ilyaZar
description: A command-palette plugin manager for Omarchy with a built-in security scanner. Browse, add, enable, disable, update and remove shell plugins from a table UI, and see a static + optional AI security review of a plugin's code before you enable or update it. Forked from ilyaZar/plugin-control. The palette opens only when summoned, so it stays light in the background.
